lesson.title: Determinants, invertibility and computational checks
externalRequires: P101 U01 programming readiness as specified at U02-L05.
lesson.purpose: Interpret a 2-by-2 determinant and validate transformation and solution calculations transparently.
lesson.scope: ad−bc, signed area scale and collapse in 2D; determinant nonzero as the invertibility condition; obtain/check a simple inverse by reversing a transformation or solving for its columns; substitute hand solutions into original systems.
lesson.boundary: No 3-by-3 determinant expansion, general inverse algorithm or eigenmethods. Coding checks a supplied candidate, not an automatic solver. A zero residual is not evidence of uniqueness.
lesson.practiceAndEvidence: Use contrasting invertible and singular integer matrices; compare transformed unit-square area with determinant; write a 2-by-2 transformation function and residual calculation; test a valid, invalid and dependent-system candidate. Explain each check’s limits.
lesson.visualPlan: Unit square transformed into parallelogram or collapsed line, with orientation clearly labelled.
lesson.python: 2 hours included: independently implement a fixed small matrix-vector calculation and residual check with lists/functions, explain results and rerun cleanly. No solver, arrays or plotting required.
lesson.handover: L06 integrates O4/O6 evidence; M102 will extend bases, orthogonality and eigenmethods.
